data.title: Add docket why command for decision history
data.body:
## Goal

Add a command to show human-readable decision history for a bug.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket why ID` shows narrative history
- [ ] Show: created with goal, status changes with timestamps
- [ ] Show: priority changes with context
- [ ] Show: major body updates (title changes)
- [ ] Format as readable narrative, not raw events
- [ ] Include actor (who/what made each change)

## Context

`docket log` shows raw events in JSON or structured format. `docket why` would show a human-readable narrative:

```
Bug abc1: Add user authentication

Created: 2025-01-10 with Medium priority
  Goal: "Implement basic username/password auth"

2025-01-11: Approved for implementation
2025-01-12: Started work
2025-01-12: Priority changed to High
  (Became blocking for release)
2025-01-13: Completed
  Time in progress: 1 day
```

This is useful for understanding the history of a bug without reading raw events.
